g.title: Sends each chunk's text, with its path and line range, to the BM25 index, and the same chunk on to the embedder.
Turns each chunk into a 768-dimension vector for the vector store.
bm25.rs stores chunk text with its path and line range in a Tantivy index. Queries use the lenient parser, so code-shaped input such as foo::bar() never fails to parse.

store.rs keeps an append-only record log with tombstones, compacted when dead records outnumber live ones. hnsw.rs builds a graph snapshot (vectors.hnsw) at 1,000 records or more, and rebuilds it whenever an index run changes anything. A stale or inconsistent snapshot falls back to an exact scan.
